skills: Up to 4 Ice hits; the 4th is an Unbridled Spear attack.

In Aerial Patrol Spear with a use stored, hold: the next of its three stages for Ice DMG (cycles 1 → 3). Charging stages 1–2 blocks attacks: a block negates the hit, refreshes the state, gives a use and +100% Daze to the next one. Keeps her Basic combo count. 60% DMG reduction.
Frost-charged counter for Ice DMG; keeps her Basic combo count. Unbridled Spear.
Parries an incoming attack for massive Daze.
Upswing and heavy slam for massive Ice DMG. Unbridled Spear.
Two versions of a powerful stab flurry for massive Ice DMG (Shattered lunges forward). Keep her Basic combo count. Unbridled Spear.

Piercing strike for massive Ice DMG; Converging Spear +20% DMG for 50s. First hit on a Stunned elite or boss starts Formation Breaker: hold to run all three Converging Spear stages in a row (state timer paused), then her stage is restored. Once per Stun. Unbridled Spear.
Lunging barrage for massive Ice DMG. Unbridled Spear.

core.name: Sky Knight
core.text:
Unbridled Spear hits enter or refresh Aerial Patrol Spear and give 1 Converging Spear use (doesn't stack). It lasts 8 / 7 / 6s at stage 1 / 2 / 3, and the stage drops by 1 when it ends.
Entering or refreshing it gives +66% CRIT Rate for 8s, extending by 8s each time (max 40s). In the state, her hits on Stunned enemies get +20% Stun DMG Multiplier.

ability.name: Legion of the Skies
ability.text: ATK +120, +12 per level (max 840). +15% DMG against Contaminated enemies.

mindscapes: Stage 3 Converging Spear enters Aerial Patrol Spear and gives an extra use; uses past the cap add 100% ATK as Ice DMG to the next one's last hit. +25% ATK.
Unbridled Spear and Converging Spear get +24% PEN Ratio. Aerial Patrol Spear lasts 2s longer. +10% Decibel generation.
Gaining Aerial Patrol Spear gives +18% DMG for 8s, extending by 8s each time (max 40s).
Converging Spear's last hit adds 80% / 90% / 100% ATK as Ice DMG at stage 1 / 2 / 3. No limit on Formation Breaker per Stun, and its Converging Spears are faster.
